source_of_truth: sites/_kit (four repos are generated from it by make.mjs)

lock.aesthetic_unit: none-new — the house system wins; extract only design-taste-frontend's ban list
banned: minimalist-ui (one fixed look; would erase four metaphors)
inspo corpus (project has a design system; S3 says suppress)
any build/generate script during audit or read stages

ground.namespace_reserved: --t-* and --c-* belong to canvas.css/faces.css, written on .face[data-product] at (0,2,0); NEVER declare one in base.css or responsive.css. --t-mono is a font-family, not a size.
ground.ladder_file: src/css/responsive.css — appended LAST in build.mjs SHEETS; every rule must sit inside a width<=1200 or capability query
ground.mock_trap: .face is NOT a mock root — every page mounts <main class="page face canvas">, so a .face-scoped selector reaches the whole document
ground.build_trap: squeeze() collapses `\s*([{};:,>])\s*` so `X :is(...)` ships as `X:is(...)` and matches nothing. Write `X *:is(...)`.

honesty_rules: No invented product facts, metrics, customers, testimonials, logos or case studies. Three of the four products are pre-launch.
A feature that displays a number must read it from real data or say plainly it is a demo.
gates: node tools/check.mjs — feature probes against built bytes, floor 25, no ceiling
node tools/shots.mjs --all --mobile — 320/390/430, fails on sideways scroll, console errors, inputs <16px, controls <40px
desaudit: twodesign.mjs, mobile-gate.mjs, deskgate.mjs, physics.mjs, craftbar.mjs
known_false_positives: binderkit's 13 dead-control blockers are one Print button (js/site.js:341 window.print(); headless suppresses the dialog)
motion-budget 560/600/900ms is deliberate metaphor motion declared as --t-dur-*
safari-skips-links is a macOS Safari preference, off by default

direction.commits_to: Conviction comes from the product running inside the page. Every new feature is a live instrument the visitor can operate without signing up: the full-bleed film strip of every real screen, interactive simulators, a hero device whose screen can be switched, annotated desktop shells, scroll-driven walkthroughs. A partner forms an opinion by USING it.

shrinks: caption and chrome type above the floors
holds: instrument zoom never below 0.8 on phones — the product screens ARE the pitch
mobile_20pct.target: ~20% more page visible per phone screen, nothing harder to read or press

direction.verify_recipe: cd sites/_kit && PRODUCT=<id> DIST=<private tmp> node build.mjs && PRODUCT=<id> DIST=<private tmp> node tools/check.mjs  — fully parallel-safe, touches no site directory

binderkit.extra: type.h1-cap x2 — the 20% headline cut may close these
